channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday contests 2026 (Canada)
channel.description: Contests and giveaways open to residents of Canada that are tied to Black Friday (Friday, November 27, 2026) and Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026), each checked on the organizer's own page. Many close within days of Black Friday, so check the closing date on each one. Only entries we have confirmed as open are listed.

item.title: Mondou Black Friday: 2 cartes-cadeaux de 500 $ – Mondou
item.description: Prize: 2 cartes-cadeaux Mondou de 500 $ chacune. Deadline: November 4, 2026. Participation en ligne avec nom, prénom et courriel; l'inscription à l'infolettre donne une participation de plus (2 maximum). Aucun achat requis. Majeurs résidant au Québec. Du 1er octobre au 4 novembre 2026, tirage le 5 novembre

item.title: ELLE Canada 2026 Beauty Grand Prix contest – ELLE Canada
item.description: Prize: Every product from the 2026 Beauty Grand Prix winners (approx. CA$4,000 prize pack). Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter on the ELLE Canada contest page. Open to residents of Canada of age of majority; one entry per person. Oct 22 - Nov 29, 2026 11:59 PM ET; the winning brands are revealed in the November issue

item.title: ACON Black Friday 2026 "Ultimate Backyard Setup" Giveaway (Canada) – ACON
item.description: Prize: ACON X 17ft trampoline + Soccer Goal Panel + Basketball Hoop with Back Net (worth CA$6,477). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on ACON's Canadian Black Friday page (joins the ACON VIP newsletter). Free. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 1:00 AM EST

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (CA) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV CA$999) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Canadian residents of the age of majority. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: Rubicon x Nintendo Switch 2 National Contest – Rubicon Exotic
item.description: Prize: 30 Nintendo Switch 2 consoles, each with a Super Mario Party Jamboree digital code. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the contest page once per day (also possible by mail). No purchase necessary, residents of Canada excluding Quebec, age of majority. Runs Oct 15 - Nov 30, 2026; draw around Dec 10

item.title: CYBEX Club prize draw (instant win) – CYBEX Canada
item.description: Prize: 14 instant-win prizes: e-Gazelle stroller, 3 Aton 2 infant car seats, 5 Laya carriers, 5 x $50 gift cards (total approx. CA$4,909); everyone else gets a 10% voucher. Deadline: December 3, 2026. Sign in or create a free CYBEX MyAccount on the CYBEX Canada Online Shop and click Play on the contest page. No purchase necessary, residents of Canada, age of majority. Oct 20 - Dec 3, 2026
